title: Mollification approximates a C¹_c function in directional-derivative sup norm with support control
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ of class C¹ with compact support, δ > 0, v ∈ ℝⁿ and ε > 0. Then there is ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝ of class C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) with compact support such that tsupport ψ ⊆ cthickening δ (tsupport φ) (the closed δ-neighbourhood of the topological support of φ) and |Dψ(x)v − Dφ(x)v| ≤ ε for every x ∈ ℝⁿ (Df(x)v = fderiv ℝ f x v).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Euclid n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∀ (v : Euclid n) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ ψ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ cthickening δ (tsupport φ) ∧ ∀ x, |fderiv ℝ ψ x v - fderiv ℝ φ x v| ≤ ε
